extracted.name: All in One Beef Pot
extracted.description: Great recipe for All in One Beef Pot.
instruction_lines: In a large saucepan or skillet, cook the beef, onion, celery and green pepper over medium heat until the vegetables are crisp-tender and meat is no longer pink
Drain the contents and return to heat
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt if desired, basil and pepper
Stir in the noodles, beans, tomatoes, water and bouillon
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until noodles are tender, stirring occasionally
